build.reason: The recipe builds and links xinclude, but the Autotools feature defaults controlling inclusion of xinclude.c and related features are not supplied.

input.reason: The entry reads fuzz supplied options, allocation limit, and framed URL/entity strings; the first entity supplies the document and URL, so document content and external entity names are input controlled.

lifecycle.reason: The entry calls context, document, parser, and fuzz data cleanup, and context cleanup accepts NULL, but the fuzz data cleanup contract is not supplied.

control_flow.reason: ProcessNode calls DoProcessRoot, which calls the omitted xmlXIncludeDoProcess body. The route from entry to the changed include and error operations cannot be completed.
